scope: Independent static review of production composition, fixture implementation and recorded standalone PASS; reviewer did not execute tests, targets or native providers
checks: ThreadEffects delegates required_preserve_error_064b90 to actual existing PTD source; cached live Ptd fixture mutates LastError during FLS access and restoration is observed
UpdateEffects delegates both refresh methods to actual locale-thread cores; WildcardEffects delegates actual constructor
Live Ptd, locale/multibyte storage and Globals are borrowed into one bounded Lower memory provider; globals current multibyte cell address resolves to that same live Globals object
Parser byte classification, previous-byte helpers and code-page cleanup use returned context PTD and shared flag word; clear byte gates cleanup
Nested constructor/classification retain bit 2 until outer explicit cleanup; global and explicit-pair paths acquire no PTD and return clear flag zero
Transition fixture exercises both real refresh cores, lock 4/5, old static-object exemptions, updated PTD pair and reference counts
Allocated non-static old multibyte pointer refcount 1 flows through actual recovered free_0668c0 and heap effect, removing both heap-memory and reported-size records
Whole argv mode 1/mode 2 uses actual parser, expansion, generic sort, conversion, path and SDK-shaped find wrappers with controlled function-pointer fixtures
Integrated UTF8 and ANSI/OEM-selection variants verify argv publication, find closure, cleanup, realloc/final allocation failures and flag ownership balance
Same heap bridge is used by onexit with recursive registration, moved/in-place recalloc, failed growth preservation and capacity-based zero ranges
limitations: Deep locale add/release/free, locks, atomics, FLS access and lower Windows conversion/find/module functions are controlled fixtures; concurrency and production native backend behavior remain unproven
Required PTD is tested through cached live-Ptd and construction-sentinel abort cases; allocation, construction and FLS initialization/destruction are not exercised by this integration suite
ctype-mask classification path is not integrated here; tests use multibyte lead-byte bit 4 and ASCII conversion fixtures, so comprehensive native Unicode/codepage behavior is not established
Optional error-slot PTD provider is independently controlled and usually falls back; this does not prove global unification of every error/invalid/PTD provider with the shared locale Ptd
Caller is responsible for live address binding and serialized access to Globals; synthetic tests do not establish races, native atomic semantics, original initialization or ABI equivalence
Fast-path PTD zero in bridge context is explicit new metadata safe only because clear flag is zero; original constructor leaves that qword untouched
No exceptional/SEH cleanup, full DLL link/runtime equivalence or original binary execution is claimed
